title: UN Women AI School
summary: UN Women describes hands-on use of generative AI and custom GPTs for research, knowledge products and advocacy. The chapter does not measure AI’s effect on learning or workplace performance.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The UN Women AI School describes participants using tools including ChatGPT, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot for research, knowledge products, content creation and advocacy. Hands-on activities include developing custom GPTs and adapting them to policy briefs, proposals and other work. The chapter links custom GPTs for humanitarian work, technology-facilitated gender-based violence and women’s empowerment principles. These AI-assisted tasks are the basis for inclusion. The program’s reported attendance and satisfaction do not establish AI’s causal effect on learning. Neither learning gains from AI nor downstream workplace improvements are separately measured.
purpose: Use generative AI in practical learning, research, knowledge management and advocacy work.
system: UN Women AI School generative-AI activities and custom GPTs
developer: UN Women and program partners (custom GPT configurations)
deployer: UN Women Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific

ratings.reason: Participants use generative AI in practical tasks and custom GPT development. The extent of any learning improvement caused by AI is not measured; attendance and satisfaction describe the overall program.
Custom GPTs and AI-assisted research or knowledge products are intended to improve UN and civil-society work. No separate workplace productivity or quality improvement is measured.

ai_role.statement: Generative AI contributes directly to participants’ research, drafting and custom-GPT exercises. Human teaching also contributes; program attendance and satisfaction do not isolate AI’s learning benefit.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use case 7: UN Women AI School

produced_by: Generative-AI use in practical exercises and custom GPT configuration
